parameters.subject: Welcome to Duct Tape Games
parameters.text:
=Hi {{ $json.body.name }},

Your Duct Tape Games account is ready. Your Battle Planes progress is saved to it, so you can sign in with Google on any browser and pick up where you left off.

Play Battle Planes in your browser: https://www.ducttapegames.com/games
Your profile: https://www.ducttapegames.com/html/profile.html

Battle Planes is Avioane, the Romanian notebook game: hide your planes, call your shots, and find out if each one is a hit, a miss or a kill.

Questions? Write to support@ducttapegames.com.

See you in the sky,
Duct Tape Games

You're getting this one-time email because you made an account on ducttapegames.com.
